svg.title: SafeChat AI architecture
svg.desc: Trust boundaries and numbered data flows of SafeChat AI. Real values exist only in the employee's browser, which masks sensitive data before calling the AI provider with the user's own key, seals the token map, chat and API key per data type with TideCloak self-encryption, and sends only ciphertext to the SafeChat server. The Tide network signs tokens, gates every seal and unseal by role, and applies role changes only after 2 of 3 admins approve.
svg.text: Real values stay in the employee’s browser. The AI provider sees tokens; the server, store and admins see ciphertext.
Accountant with safechat-staff. Real values live only here.
Remind Minh Phat Trading Co., Ltd. to pay
Company and person names, tax IDs, citizen IDs,
bank accounts, amounts, phones and emails become
tokens like [COMPANY_1]. Replies are unmasked here.
Token map, chat transcript and API key are sealed with
TideCloak self-encryption, one tag per data type:
AI providercalled directly from the browser with the user’s own key (BYOK)
OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini. Receives masked text only and replies with tokens.
Stores ciphertext only. Holds no key.
